rationale: Builds directly on the current two-block tail-recurrence winner instead of resetting direction. The repeated tail blocks no longer reuse the token-embedding anchor during the second traversal; each recurrent pass now reuses that block's own first-pass input as its residual anchor, so the existing learned resid_mix controls can refine around a deeper, on-distribution state instead of being tugged back toward shallow features. This is a minimal recurrent-depth transplant with no new model parameters, no extra hot-loop compute beyond the current best, and unchanged exact int8+zlib evaluation or artifact format.
title: First-Pass Anchored Tail Recurrence
